M2E2_pure.symmetry: Strictly symmetric around E0/2, maximum at midpoint (330.8 keV)

E3M1_pure.symmetry: U-shaped with local minimum at midpoint, maximum towards asymmetric sharing

Walz_2015_Nature.detectors: 5 LaBr3 at 72 deg and 144 deg only (no energy-sharing discrimination)

Soderstrom_2020_NatCommun.detectors: 11 CeBr3 at 5 angles (32.7 to 163.6 deg) with full continuous energy sharing
Soderstrom_2020_NatCommun.predicted_shape_profile: Distinct U-shaped dip at 331 keV, matching measured continuous spectra

microscopic_origin.M2_hindrance: B(M2) single-particle transition is forbidden by Delta l = 3, suppressed by ~10^-3
microscopic_origin.E3_collective_enhancement: E3 virtual transition couples directly to the collective 3- octupole phonon of the 138Ba core (B(E3) ~ 25 W.u.)
microscopic_origin.conclusion: Continuous energy-sharing breaks the two-fold angular ambiguity, decisively establishing octupole-dipole (E3M1) dominance over quadrupole-quadrupole.
